name: GKE - Node Logs
description: The GKE - Node Logs - dashboard displays information on the overall health of the nodes, along with highlights on errors, warnings, and unusual conditions.
title: GKE - Node Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* jsonPayload logName source host 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload.source.host" as labels, node
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| timeslice 1h 
| count by _timeslice, node, cluster, project
| transpose row _timeslice column node, cluster, project
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* jsonPayload logName source host 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload" as labels, payload
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "reason", "source.host" as reason, node
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| count as events by reason, node, cluster, project
| transpose row node, cluster, project column reason

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName reason host 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.jsonPayload", "message.data.severity" as labels, payload, severity
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| json field=payload "reason", "source.host" as reason, node
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| if (severity in ("ERROR","WARNING", "ALERT", "CRITICAL", "FATAL", "EMERGENCY"), 1, 0) as error
| count as events, sum(error) as errors by node, cluster, project
| errors / events as error_pct
| sort by events

panels.title: Scheduled Pods by Node Over Time

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName "\"reason\":\"Scheduled\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels" as labels
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
| parse regex "\"message\":\"[^\"]* assigned (?<pod>[^\" ]+) to (?<node>[^\" ]+)"
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| timeslice 1h 
| count as eventCount by _timeslice, node, cluster, project
| transpose row _timeslice column node, cluster, project
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)

_sourceCategory = Labs/gcp/kubernetes* logName "\"reason\":\"Scheduled\""
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\""
| where log_name matches "projects/*/logs/events"
| json "message.data.resource.labels", "message.data.timestamp", "message.data.jsonPayload.message" as labels, timestamp, message
| json field=labels "project_id", "cluster_name" as project, cluster
//| parse regex "\"message\":\"[^\"]* assigned (?<pod>[^\" ]+) to (?<node>[^\" ]+)"
| parse regex field=message "[^\"]* assigned (?<pod>[^\" ]+) to (?<node>[^\" ]+)"
| where node matches "{{node}}"
| count as events by timestamp, message, pod, node, cluster, project
| sort by timestamp asc
| 1 as event
| accum event as scheduled by node, cluster, project
| fields timestamp, message, pod, node, cluster, project, scheduled
| sort by timestamp
